messages:
maria: opened a docs PR adding small preflight cert-validation scripts for private/offline installs (ps1 + sh). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4822

alex: nice. quick ask — add a clear warning about private key handling and show minimal file perms (chmod 600 / Set-Acl) by the PS example. also include sample failure output so users can recognise problems. :+1:

sam: left some inline comments. for PowerShell prefer `Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256`. some customers still on PS5 — can we add a 1-line fallback using .NET crypto if Get-FileHash not present?

maria: will add a fallback that tries `Get-FileHash` then falls back to `[System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()` for PS5.

tina: docs-ci shouldn't hit real KMS endpoints. add a `--dry-run` flag that validates bundles/checksums but skips network handshakes. also include a short appendix showing how to run the handshake against a local testserver (openssl s_server + python -m http.server).

infra-bot: docs-ci: build for PR 4822 succeeded — artifacts: https://ci.redwood.dev/artifacts/4822/ (includes sample output & lint report) :white_check_mark:

maria: added `--dry-run` and `--no-network`, included testserver appendix. also added an optional systemd unit example for a local cert-cache helper.

jeff: nit: rename `$bundlePath` -> `$certBundlePath` in PS to avoid ambiguity with other bundles.

sam: suggest an optional pkcs11 one-liner for HSM users: `pkcs11-tool --list-objects -l -k` (document provider path requirement). mark it optional and platform-specific.

maria: added pkcs11 snippet, labeled optional, and a short note about not committing lib paths/creds.

tina: add simple tracer checks for blocked ports (tcp/443, tcp/8443) and DNS resolution examples (nslookup/dig) in troubleshooting.

maria: included tracer checks and a "When things fail" list: expired cert, SAN mismatch, MTU/NAT issues, captive proxies. added example outputs for each.

security: reviewed, acked. requested a paragraph on rotating ephemeral certs used in CI and a reminder to avoid logging private DER blobs; linked Key Handling policy.

maria: updated PR with all changes and pinged @docs-owners for final sign-off.

alex: quick pass done, LGTM from docs side.

infra-bot: docs-ci: all checks passed for PR 4822 (lint, linkcheck, script dry-run).

maria: merged after approvals and green CI. closing the loop — thanks all! :tada:

maria: follow-up planned: small PR to add Windows note about `Set-AuthenticodeSignature` and link to installer FAQ.

sam: saved the sample scripts into internal snippet repo for support use.

maria: archived artifacts and added changelog entry under docs release notes. thread closed.
